item.title: Tackling alert noise - Lessons from building and using an alerting system
item.description: If you’ve dealt with alerts for any non-trivial amount of time, you’ve likely dealt with “alert noise”. Too many alerts. Breaking flow state. Or worse, breaking sleep. Breaking either isn’t nice (Breaking bad. ba dum tss!). It’s not bad just for sanity, but for the very purpose with which one sets alerts – Monitoring (or debugging. We’ll get to the difference) (No, leave my beloved em dash alone. I added it myself. There is no AI in this blog).
